p: Anderson filled in for McCormick at guard and is the likely replacement if McCormick is sidelined.
He may be the interior line starter if McCormick misses time, which affects run and pass blocking.
Will take over McCormick's spot on the offensive line (left guard) as the next man up.
He moves into a starting offensive line role, which matters for the run game and for the jumbo packages he has been part of.
Will keep getting opportunities in the jumbo package and as an extra lineman or tight-end-type piece.
Jumbo sets (12 carries, 79 yards) feed the run game, which helps the backs and short-yardage touchdown chances.
